solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Disease caught off insects

indicators.note: off tells us one piece is taken away from the insects, leaving the rest

parts.note: crickets are chirping insects
C is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: Someone catches an illness from a bug bite.
explanation.walkthrough: 'caught' looks like part of the story of infection, but it is the letter C, removed by 'off'.
explanation.definitionFit: Rickets is a childhood bone condition caused by lack of vitamin D, a named illness.

clue.text: Finding new body to control motor race

parts.note: to rein in is to control
a motor is a car
a nation is a people, a race

explanation.surface: Someone takes charge of a car rally.
explanation.definitionFit: Rebirth of the soul in another form means acquiring a fresh physical self after death.

clue.text: Despicable sort, a murderer, endlessly spat

indicators.note: endlessly means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: Cain killed Abel, the first murderer in the Bible
a tiff is a minor quarrel, a spat

explanation.surface: A villain, a killer who never stops quarrelling.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic word for a contemptible coward or wretch, a base person.

clue.text: Medical treatment contributing to hygiene, mainly

indicators.note: contributing to says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A treatment that mostly aids cleanliness.
explanation.definitionFit: A rectal injection of fluid to clean the bowel is a standard medical procedure.

clue.text: After a bit son knocks off

indicators.note: After puts the son after the bit in the answer

parts.note: a snaffle is a type of bit for a horse

explanation.surface: A son, after a while, stops work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a bit' looks like 'a while', but it is a horse's mouthpiece; 'knocks off' means steals, not stops work.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are informal verbs meaning to steal or pinch something.

clue.text: Well bored by Democrat (eg) rambling, you may do this

indicators.note: bored by means the first piece has a hole drilled in it to hold the second

parts.note: well, as in healthy, means fit

indicators.note: rambling signals the letters wander into a new order

explanation.surface: A rambling politician's speech is so dull that the listener squirms.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Well' looks like a sentence opener, but it means healthy; '(eg)' looks like an aside but is fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Squirming restlessly is what a bored listener tends to do, so the verb fits the loose phrase.

clue.text: What will be the odds of fruit tree containing uranium?

indicators.note: containing means the picked letters hold the next piece
the odds are the odd-numbered letters, first, third, fifth and so on

parts.note: U is the chemical symbol for uranium

explanation.surface: A gambler asks the odds on a fruit tree holding radioactive metal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'odds' reads as betting odds; it means the odd letters, FUTRE.
explanation.definitionFit: Time yet to come is everything that is going to happen.

clue.text: With parent around, children avoid dog

indicators.note: around means the parent wraps the other pieces

parts.note: a dad is a parent
to shun is to avoid

explanation.surface: When the father is near, the kids keep away from the dog.
explanation.definitionFit: A sausage dog is a short-legged German breed of hound.

clue.text: Can the new cast work magic?

indicators.note: cast means the letters are thrown into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A director wonders if the new cast can work wonders.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cast' looks like a troupe of actors, but it is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To put someone under a spell is to bewitch them with sorcery.

clue.text: I can take a long time getting books for travelling

parts.note: a can is a tin container
an era is a long period of history
NT is the New Testament, a set of books of the Bible

explanation.surface: A slow reader says it takes ages to fetch books for a journey.
explanation.definitionFit: An itinerant preacher or worker moves from place to place, always on the road.

clue.text: In outskirts of capital city one will find him

indicators.note: In places the following pieces inside the outer letters
outskirts are the edges, so only the first and last letters are used

parts.note: EC is the postcode for the City of London
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone says that a certain man can be found on the edge of a capital city.
explanation.walkthrough: EC is the postcode district of the City, London's financial centre.
explanation.definitionFit: A man's name stands for a male person, so a pronoun for a man is a fair, if teasing, definition.

clue.text: Playing Romeo etc Peter felt able to deliver lines flawlessly

indicators.note: Playing suggests the letters are played with into a new order

parts.note: R is Romeo in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: An actor playing Romeo felt word-perfect.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Romeo' only gives its initial R, the phonetic alphabet's letter.
explanation.definitionFit: An actor who has memorised the script exactly knows every word and speaks without error.

clue.text: Tea's fashionable for imbibing here

indicators.note: imbibing means drinking in, so the tea word swallows the other piece

parts.note: cha is slang for tea
in means fashionable, as in the in thing

explanation.surface: A trendy tea that is now the drink of choice.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition 'here' points back at the tea-drinking scene: China is where tea comes from and is the crockery you drink it from.
explanation.definitionFit: A cup of fine porcelain, or the tea-growing country, is the place where such drinking happens.

clue.text: Female's cooking a roast? Turkey's brought round to begin with

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for female

indicators.note: cooking means the letters are worked over into something new
brought round means the piece is turned to face the other way

parts.note: TR is the international vehicle code for Turkey

explanation.surface: A woman is roasting a turkey and turns it in the oven.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turkey' reads as the bird being roasted, but it is the country, by its international vehicle code.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an idiom meaning initially, as a first step, just like the clue phrase.

clue.text: For example Martin Luther King's European past

parts.note: R is short for Rex, king
former means past or previous

explanation.surface: It seems to describe Martin Luther King's European ancestry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Martin Luther King' reads as the civil rights leader, but the definition stops at Luther, the German churchman; King gives R.
explanation.definitionFit: Martin Luther led the Protestant Reformation, so he is a classic example of a religious reformer.

clue.text: Reviving very important research first of all

parts.note: res is the abbreviation for research, and first of all says it is put at the front
urgent means very important, pressing

explanation.surface: It sounds like a priority for vital research.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first of all' only says the research abbreviation goes at the front, ahead of the clue's first piece.
explanation.definitionFit: A resurgent force is rising again after a decline, coming back to life.

clue.text: To steal is way to break law

indicators.note: to break means the first piece goes into the law, splitting it

parts.note: a rule is a law
St is the abbreviation for street, a way

explanation.surface: A moralist says stealing is a way of breaking the law.
explanation.definitionFit: Rustling is stealing livestock such as cattle or horses, a specific kind of theft.

clue.text: Large-scale piece or a smaller one about love

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: about means the smaller piece goes around the love letter

parts.note: a trio is a small piece for three players
O is zero, love in tennis

explanation.surface: A composer weighs a big work against a smaller one about love.
explanation.definitionFit: A grand choral and orchestral work on a sacred theme, like Handel's Messiah.

clue.text: Confront accountant about amount to be paid

indicators.note: about means turned round, so the letters are read in the opposite order

parts.note: CA is a chartered accountant
a cost is a price to be paid

explanation.surface: Someone challenges their accountant over a bill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' looks like 'concerning' but it turns CA round.
explanation.definitionFit: To accost someone is to approach and speak to them boldly, often aggressively, which is to confront them.

clue.text: Fancy an island cottage for vacation?

parts.note: Capri is an island off Naples

indicators.note: vacation means emptying, so the inside of the word goes and its ends remain

explanation.surface: Would you like a holiday cottage on an island?
explanation.walkthrough: 'vacation' reads as holiday; it means vacating the word's middle.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden whim or impulse is a passing fancy.

clue.text: To mention what's best forgotten is awfully rude, Penny agreed regularly

indicators.note: awfully suggests something badly mangled, so the letters are jumbled
regularly means every other letter is taken

explanation.surface: Penny agrees that someone was terribly rude to bring up an awkward subject.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes GED from agreed; with RUDE and P, 'awfully' shuffles them. 'Penny' looks like a woman's name but is the coin.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means to bring up unpleasant past matters, raking over something better left buried.

clue.text: State of America not about to change, note

indicators.note: to change means the remaining letters are rearranged
not says the letters for about are removed

parts.note: ca is short for circa, about
te is a note in tonic sol-fa

explanation.surface: An American state that will not change.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing CA from AMERICA leaves AMERI, which 'to change' rearranges to EMIRA.
explanation.definitionFit: A Gulf territory ruled by an emir, such as Dubai, is a state.

clue.text: Footballer who gives unconvincing performance?

definitions.meaning: an overacting performer, a ham actor

explanation.walkthrough: West Ham United is a London football club; its players are the Hammers.
explanation.definitionFit: A ham is an overacting performer, so one who hams is an unconvincing player; the club nickname gives the other sense.

clue.text: I am left by social worker to provide material

parts.note: I'm is the contraction of I am
port is the left side of a ship
an ant is a social insect that works in a colony

explanation.surface: A client is left material by a social worker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'social worker' sounds like a council job, but it is an ant, a social insect.
explanation.definitionFit: Material in the legal sense means relevant and significant, which is a synonym of the answer.

clue.text: Sportsman's a lazy fellow? Not very

indicators.note: Not says one piece is to be left out of the lazy fellow

parts.note: a skiver is a shirker who avoids work

explanation.surface: Is the sportsman a lazy fellow? Not very.
explanation.walkthrough: A skiver is British slang for someone dodging work or school.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who skis competitively or for fun is a sportsman on the slopes.

clue.text: University bar outwardly is sophisticated

indicators.note: outwardly means the bar word sits on the outside of the other

parts.note: save means bar, except

explanation.surface: A campus bar that looks classy from outside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bar' looks like a pub, but it means except.
explanation.definitionFit: A smooth, urbane manner is a polished, worldly one.

clue.text: One with flair for protection racket

indicators.note: for protection means the second piece is sheltered inside the first

parts.note: a nose is a flair or knack for finding something
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A gangster with a talent for running a protection racket.
explanation.walkthrough: 'protection racket' looks like a single phrase; 'racket' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A racket is a loud din, so the two words are straightforward synonyms.

clue.text: Forced to detain returning soldiers, sickness spread

indicators.note: to detain means the first piece holds the others inside it

parts.note: made means forced, as in made him do it

indicators.note: returning means the letters go back the other way

parts.note: RA is the Royal Artillery, a body of soldiers
mal is French for illness, as in mal de mer

explanation.surface: Troops are held back while a disease spreads.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spread' looks like the disease's progress, but it is the noun for something put on toast.
explanation.definitionFit: Orange preserve is a spread for toast, so the noun spread names it.

clue.text: Bully for him!

definitions.meaning: to bully is to browbeat or intimidate, a verb
a man's name, standing for a male person

explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads as the cheer 'Bully for him!'; the verb derives from the Trojan hero of that name.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to intimidate, and it is also a man's first name, so both senses work.

clue.text: Team should undress in public? Get stuffed!

indicators.note: in places the stripped piece inside the public word

parts.note: overt means open, done in public

indicators.note: undressing removes the outer layers, so only the middle letters stay

explanation.surface: A rude retort to a team stripping in public.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Get stuffed!' looks like an insult, but taken literally it means eat too much.
explanation.definitionFit: To get stuffed literally is to eat to excess, gorging until full.
